hooks.command: bash -c 'f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$f" == *.html || "$f" == *.css ]]; then npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null && echo "[hook] formatted $f"; fi; if [[ "$f" == *.js || "$f" == *.sql || "$f" == *.py ]]; then new_tables=$(cd /c/Users/muroc/project_home && git diff HEAD -- "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep "^+.*CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS" | grep -o "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS [a-z_]*" | sed "s/CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS //" | tr "\n" " "); if [[ -n "$new_tables" ]]; then echo "[hook] ⚠ NEW DB table(s) added: ${new_tables}— add to: 1) retention_policies in ensureSchema(), 2) Project Health DB Volumes tab"; fi; fi'
